user_direction: Continue A2 with a comfortable idle stance, and correct the impression of excessively long legs.
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: Megumin concept A2. Image 2 is an official Megumin model sheet, used ONLY as a proportion and canonical costume reference.
Create one revised full-body IDLE BASE POSE that looks comfortable to stand in for a long time. The user wants to continue A2's identity and right-facing orientation, but finds the current stance posed/stiff and the legs too long.

TWO REQUIRED CORRECTIONS:
1. PROPORTIONS: visibly correct the long-legged fashion-model impression of A2. Shorten the total hip-to-sole length by roughly 12–15 percent relative to the current upper body, especially the overextended lower-leg impression, keeping anatomically believable thigh/shin lengths and knees in the right place. Let the head read slightly larger relative to the body (approximately 5 percent), aiming for the petite ordinary-anime proportions of the official sheet, around six heads total excluding the wizard hat. Preserve a compact torso; do NOT lengthen the torso as a workaround, do NOT merely lower the camera, widen the stance or hide long legs with the cape, and do NOT make her chibi. Redraw the legs and boots at the correct shorter proportions with natural joints and normal boot sizes, never squash pixels.
2. COMFORTABLE IDLE: coherent three-quarter whole-body view toward SCREEN RIGHT as in A2, about 40–45 degrees. Upright balanced torso, pelvis almost level, shoulders lowered, neck relaxed, no model S-curve or exaggerated hip shift. Feet naturally spaced about hip width with clear slight space between the boots, both soles planted on one ground plane, toes generally diagonal right with modest natural outward angle. Knees unlocked but near straight; no crouching, pigeon toes, crossed legs, wide battle stance or military heels-together stance. The weight feels comfortably supported rather than leaning on one locked knee.

ARMS AND STAFF: her anatomical RIGHT upper arm hangs near the side of her ribcage instead of being held out to the side. Bend that elbow gently so the right hand rests at roughly waist/low-rib height, loosely but correctly gripping the staff. Hold the staff near vertical at her right side, slightly outside the silhouette, with its lower tip resting on the same ground plane as her boots, taking the effort out of holding it. No arm raised to chest/shoulder height. Anatomical LEFT arm hangs with relaxed shoulder and a soft elbow, hand close to the side of the thigh, fingers loosely curled, not spread for presentation and not clenched. Leave a subtle readable gap between hand and dress. Cape hangs quietly under gravity behind her, not billowing sideways.

PRESERVE: A2's recognizable compact face, dark chestnut bob and two longer framing locks, crimson eyes, calm slightly knowing closed smile, gaze toward screen-right with both eyes visible. Same standard red/gold dress, lacing, belt and silver buckle, choker, dark cape and golden edge, fingerless gloves, orange boots. Anatomical RIGHT leg remains white-bandaged and LEFT leg remains in the dark stocking; don't swap them or mirror the figure. Same forked wooden staff with one red orb and wrapped shaft. Hat has exactly one bent tip and one yellow-orange tassel, two red/gold cross badges and the same zigzag band. Maintain accurate character identity and the same clean anime cel linework/color scheme.

Output one complete, comfortable idle character illustration. Full hat, staff and both feet with generous clear margin. Eye-level camera. True transparent alpha background, no haze or colored backdrop, no ground-plane drawing or floor shadow, no magic effects, no captions. Do not include the model sheet or duplicate characters.
